title: Wren and the Regiment
author: Elodie Vasquez
blurb: Silas Nystrom, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
